# Cognitive Workspace

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 0 · Home

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:44c0b2c39821d566 -->
enable-spa is the web portal of e-Nable Italia for managing requests for 3D-printed prosthetic devices and for coordinating the association's volunteers. This space is organised on a numbered skeleton: context and objectives (1), architecture (3), functional specifications (4), interfaces (5), operations (6), quality and verification (7), open points (8) and node references (9). Section 0 holds the reading guide with a path for each role; the domain chapters, including the five that were first documented before the skeleton existed, now live in section 3 and are ordered from cross-cutting foundations to the domains that build on them. Section 2 (plan and status) is not present because no approved project plan exists yet.
<!-- codeforge:body:end -->
